## Implemented files and behavior
src/screens/MockDrills.tsx; mock-drills-policy.ts; generated mock_drills_ops/drill_wards; contracts/mock_drills_ops.json; App authorized route, native PDF path/session recheck, scoped styles, catalogue/task/help mapping and real EN/UR images.
Default server department/shift coverage shows actual period, signed totals, missing departments/shifts and staff_drilled/active-staff; Show reports uses the actual department and server since date. Report filters/search/empty states, latest-selected detail/read errors, participants, full author stamp and follow-up states.
Draft create/edit uses actual kind/location/shift/hospital time/announced answer, measured minutes and actual staff employee IDs/roles. No prefilled successful outcome/findings or guessed IDs. Staff name/badge search, real department/ward lookups with permission-gated alternatives and no patient beds. Action owner uses a real user login, not employee ID.
Whole-report PUT includes original version and replaces participant list explicitly; conflicts preserve draft and require latest comparison/Cancel/reopen. Shared hospital-time conversion preserves unchanged seconds; fresh server clock prevents future reports.
Separate signing confirmation lists missing fields and freezes actual report; actions are separate idempotent requests with owner/deadline and backend notification. No local action completion or unsupported delete/cancel.
Existing safe-write controller retained: original actor/key/body, draft/navigation hold, explicit idempotent retry within24hours, lost PUT read/review only. Native authenticated PDF preview/Save checks MIME/signature/session/permissions; saving rechecks the session after dialog.

Incomplete Draft create committed with reply intentionally lost: original-key/body UI replay, one record; inputs/navigation locked, F1 retained draft. Actual sign/reply loss/original-key replay -> Final with returned author stamp, edit/sign absent, department Night/staff coverage increased and UI matched server counts. Fresh independent read d8e51bd0cd024c1ea2e2dd091a28abdb confirms Final/one participant/one action. Final drill has no cancellation/delete here; synthetic history and labelled Open action remain, no uncertain write.
All9 contracted routes observed successful. Native PDF preview/signature/Save/cancel and language switch passed. Unsent report/participant form retains values with EN/UR Light/DarkHighContrast250%, Urdu field F1/focus. Actual logout while native Save dialog pending refuses save/no file; original preferences restored before logout.
Reception has no route; native PDF denied before HTTP. Independent backend list403 FORBIDDEN request4102feda432346eba0aa22f00d806b98. No role-name grants or facility-category branching.
Final read-only test: actual pending PDF dialog blocks navigation, translated EN/UR warning, cancel resolves hold and warning clears. Fixes stale local App notice using existing UI clock without backend polling. Corrected RTL count/time isolation and final coverage screenshots at100/250 in both languages/themes passed and Urdu screenshot visually inspected. No business writes repeated for display fixes.
